problems_fixed.what: Duplicate solution within tier: both bronze[0] and bronze[1] had gradient 2. Changed the second point from (4,10) to (4,16) so gradient becomes 4 (distinct, clean integer). Misconception expect recomputed.

misconceptions_repaired: Every misconception on every problem was missing the required 'expect' key (validator FAIL) and was written as a bare solution, not an honest diagnosis. Rebuilt all: inverted rise/run (expect = run divided by rise), sign errors (expect = the positive magnitude), trapezium 'middles not doubled' (expect recomputed with middles counted once), and 'wrong h factor' (expect recomputed using 1/2 instead of h/2). Flat-tangent (bronze[5]) and all multiple-choice set expect:null (no single determinate wrong number). Every non-null expect verified by committing the error.
opener_concept: Two skateboard ramps drawn as right-triangles (rise 6 over run 3, then over run 2). A student reads steepness = rise divided by run by common sense, then the reveal names it the gradient, extends it to resting a ruler (tangent) on a curve, and links area-under-a-graph to a total.
